_about: Boulder County's ballot spellings of 2026 City of Boulder candidates, mapped to the names in ballot_order.json. Used only to match the county's results file to our candidate pages. Each target must be a 2026 ballot name.

sources.Grateful Fred Instead: candidates.json: the city's campaign-finance list gives the ballot name 'Grateful Fred Instead' for Fred Smith (webapps.bouldercolorado.gov committee filings). Same ballot slot (mayor, 5th) on the county page.
sources.Jill Adler Grano: endorsements.json and endorsement_verification.json cite her as 'Jill Adler Grano'. Same ballot slot (council, 10th) on the county page.
sources.Jameson (Jamo) Goldstein: Nickname in parentheses; his campaign links use 'jamo-goldstein'. Same ballot slot (mayor, 4th) on the county page.
